purpose: Attack gates #1/#5/#6/#7 only. Train a dedicated open-set head (2-layer MLP, identity + registered/unregistered heads) on E65 correlation-logSPD PCA-96 features with strictly nested leave-identity-out pseudo-unknowns, fuse it with the E65 distance gate and branch A entropy gate, and re-measure the ten gates. #9/#10 are audited but not targeted.

frozen_sources.branch_a: E182 branch A v2 (session-invariant adversarial EEGNet, 248084 params) - read only, never retrained here
frozen_sources.branch_b: E180 branch B (E65 correlation-logSPD -> per-task z -> PCA-96 -> k=12 prototypes) - read only
frozen_sources.g_entropy_loso: E182 cache/loso_v2.npz (20-fold leave-identity-out probe signals) - read only
frozen_sources.g_entropy_test: E182 cache/signals_v2.npz test_z row 4 - read only
frozen_sources.note: E183 never writes into any existing experiment directory

head.per_task_standardisation: z-score per task, statistics from that fold's pm & fit_rows rows (Train-only, held-out identity excluded)
head.pca_fit_rows: pm & fit_rows (19 enrolled identities, held-out identity excluded)
head.feature_standardisation: PCA scores z-scored with the mean/std of the fold's own training rows (K union U)
head.identity_head: Linear(64, |K|) softmax over the identities trained as registered (K)
head.repeat_aggregation: mean of per-repeat z-scored open-set logits (per-repeat z uses that repeat's training-row mean/std)
head.loss: CE(identity, K rows) + 1.0 * 0.5*(mean BCE known + mean BCE pseudo-unknown)
head.early_stop: inner validation loss on a 15% per-identity holdout of the fold's own training rows (never the eval window, never the held-out identity)
head.nesting: outer fold = held-out identity (never in any head, PCA, standardisation, prototype or threshold); inner fold = 4 of the 19 enrolled identities used as pseudo-unknown only

signals.g_head: mean over 3 inner repeats of z(open-set logit), larger = more likely registered
signals.g_dist: branch B -nearest-prototype distance, z-scored with the frozen E180 Train OOF mean/std
signals.g_entropy: branch A sum p log p, z-scored with the frozen E182 Train OOF mean/std

gate.weight_grid: simplex of (g_head, g_dist, g_entropy) with step 0.05
gate.selection_rule: argmax pooled Train LOSO gate AUC (known = 19 enrolled identities), ties by fold-mean AUC then fewer signals
gate.forbidden: no Test metric, threshold or Session field influences head training, weights or thresholds

threshold.rule: tau(a) = quantile(pooled Train LOSO known fused score, 1 - a)

loso.known_primary: window rows (0.6 < frac <= 0.8) of the 19 enrolled identities
loso.known_strict: window rows of the |K| = 15 identities the head trained as registered
loso.unknown: window rows of the held-out identity (never used for training or calibration)
loso.u_at_95: per fold: threshold = 5% quantile of that fold's known scores; fraction of unknown scores below it

attack.domain: Train window 0.6 < frac <= 0.8, stratified cap 400 per task, same subset and seed as E180/E181/E182

goals.B: broad confusion on the identity head
goals.C: boundary impersonation on the identity head
goals.D: gate evasion: maximise the fused gate (g_head + g_dist + g_entropy, all differentiable)

attack.head_assignment: each attacked trial uses the earliest outer fold in which its identity is trained as registered in all three inner repeats
attack.status: self-built white-box PGD surrogate, not the official attack suite

capacity.gate1_baseline: E182 branch A v2 in-sample argmax (frozen)
capacity.auxiliary: nearest-prototype score added to the identity logits: argmax_c (logit_c + alpha * (-d_c)), d_c = min euclidean distance to identity c prototypes
capacity.alpha_selection: alpha chosen on the 5-block OOF accuracy (Train-only), then applied unchanged to the in-sample reading
capacity.honesty: prototype-assisted in-sample accuracy is a capacity/memorisation probe, not a generalisation gain

reporting.test_official: N/A: Test has no identity labels; AUC/F1/C/RA/ASafeR/U/Score are not computable
reporting.session_usage: Test predictions are written to CSV before the Session column is read; Session is only used for the #9/#10 audit
